name: issue-dependencies
description: Audit a GitHub issue graph, distinguishing parent/sub-issue hierarchy from blocking dependencies and checking direction, counts and nesting limits. Use pasted issue text, CSV rows or JSON exports to find reversed blocker edges, conflicting parents, over-limit trees and mismatched relationship counts. Receive separate hierarchy and blocker findings with reviewable corrections and explicit counting scopes. Analyze supplied rows without accessing or changing repositories.
